facts: Simple fonts use single-byte character codes; Identity CID encodings use two-byte codes. ToUnicode maps source codes independently of rendered glyph identity.
Text and text-line matrices are distinct from saved graphics state; each BT initializes both matrices.
Character/word spacing, horizontal scale and TJ adjustments contribute to the writing-mode-specific advance. Word spacing applies to a single-byte code 32.
CID horizontal/vertical metrics are declared through W/DW and W2/DW2; vertical glyph origins differ from horizontal origins.
Source ActualText supplies replacement logical text for a marked-content range rather than independent physical geometry for every replacement scalar.
limitations: These facts do not qualify a source implementation, infer original reading order or establish ink/fidelity accuracy.
